subject: Revert format updates on config.c file for config block (#552)
reason: The change only reverts clang-format whitespace in src/config.c: each create*Config entry is collapsed back onto one line and a clang-format off/on guard is added around the static_configs table. Every config's name, alias, flags, bounds, default value, validator and apply callback is unchanged; only line breaks and comment placement differ. A pure formatting refactor with zero behaviour change needs no scenario.
